docs.title: Download the Client
docs.text: Grab the full SovereignRO game client below, extract it, and you're ready to play. Make sure you've registered an account first.

docs.title: SovereignRO — Full Client
docs.text: ~8 GB .rar archive — a direct, high-speed download from the official CDN. It starts immediately in your browser and resumes automatically if the connection drops.

docs.title: How to Install
docs.text:
1. Download the full client using the button above.
  2. Extract the .rar with WinRAR or 7-Zip (Windows can't open .rar on its own) to a folder such as C:\SovereignRO. Avoid Program Files — Windows protects it.
  3. Run the game by launching the patcher/executable inside that folder.
  4. Log in with the account you registered and start your adventure.

// If it won't launch

docs.title: Antivirus & Firewall (read this first)
docs.text:
This is the #1 reason a private-server client won't run. Custom RO clients are not code-signed like big commercial games, so Windows Defender, third-party antivirus, and the firewall often flag them as a false positive and silently quarantine or block files. It's the nature of private servers — the client is safe, it just isn't signed.

If the game won't launch, crashes instantly, or files keep disappearing after extraction:

  • Add an exclusion for the whole SovereignRO folder in Windows Defender / your antivirus (best option — keeps you protected elsewhere).
  • Or temporarily disable real-time antivirus protection and the Windows Firewall while you patch and launch.
  • Re-extract the client after adding the exclusion — deleted/quarantined files won't come back on their own.
  • Run as Administrator (right-click the game/patcher → Run as administrator).
  • Allow the game through the firewall if Windows prompts you on first launch.

docs.title: FAQ
docs.text:
Is Sovereign RO free to play?

Yes. The server and game client are free. Donations are optional and only buy cosmetic items.

Is it pay-to-win?

No. Sovereign is strictly cosmetics-only — you can spend on looks, never on power. Every fight is decided by skill.

How do I get the game client?

Download it from the Download page, extract it, and run the patcher.

The game won't open / my antivirus deleted files. What do I do?

This is common for private-server clients (they aren't code-signed, so antivirus flags them as a false positive). Add the game folder as an antivirus/firewall exclusion, re-extract the client, and run as administrator. Full steps are on the Download page.

How do I donate?

Join our Discord and message a GM. Donations are credited manually as Donation Points ($1 = 10 Donation Points).

Where do I get help?

Our Discord is the fastest place — GMs and the community help with installs, builds, and questions every day.

Don't see what you're looking for? Ask in our Discord — we're happy to help.
